result:
result: Not ready. One blocking contradiction remains in the Cowork section. The Windows, Sonnet, "What it fits" (solo bullet), Cowork, mise and README requirements are otherwise met as written. Externally sourced facts could not be checked from this session.
changed: none (read-only; paths are under /home/user/holyagent-docs unless absolute)
checks: none run. This role has no shell, and the docs-only change has no project gate to exercise. `bun fmt --check` from rep-docsfix.txt was not re-run. The table rows were checked by reading. Web sources (model-config, pricing, Cowork announcement) could not be fetched: the Exa connector needs authorization in claude.ai connector settings, and the capability stays unavailable until then.
blockers:
1. docs/usage.md:134 says "HolyAgent's skills use `name` and `description`, plus `license` for the vendored one." The shipped skills have only `name` and `description` (packages/integrations/claude/dist/skills/dev-server/SKILL.md:3-4, dist/skills/user-busy/SKILL.md:3-4). The vendored `frontend-design` text is embedded in the visual agents without its frontmatter (packages/integrations/claude/src/agents.ts:402; README.md:45). Fix: drop "plus `license` for the vendored one".
questions:
- Scope of the Windows test: the base's "Not tested" list (installer, exec-form hooks, git worktree paths, rg.exe/fd.exe) was removed, and "tested by the maintainer" now stands without scope (requirements.md:29, :37; usage.md:58; hooks.md:104). The repository holds no record of the test. Confirm the scope before merge.
- Git Bash on the maintainer's test machine: hooks.md:104 does not say whether Git Bash was installed, so the reader cannot tell whether the test covered issue 90495.
- External sources to confirm before merge: the `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL` mechanism and the `claude-sonnet-5-5` id (usage.md:120, :123), the pricing and the read date (usage.md:130), the Cowork date and the plugin-platform claims (usage.md:134). The installed claude-code 2.1.300 binary under node_modules does not contain these strings, so that check is inconclusive.
notes:
- requirements.md:10: the mise "Needed for" cell now reads "--dev installers, or Bun", which suggests mise is needed for Bun. Bun comes from Bun's own install script (components.md:9; usage.md:58), and mise is used only with `--dev` (usage.md:59). Suggest "Developing this repository; `--dev` installers".
- hooks.md:108: "as in the README table" points to a table that does not exist (README.md has none). This is pre-existing (same text in the base copy). Point it at a section that exists.
- usage.md:126: "anything else that selects the opus alias" is an inference from alias semantics. Within the repository nothing else selects `opus` (route.ts:55 `Model = haiku | sonnet`; specialist frontmatter is haiku or sonnet; the root is `opus` at dist/agents/holyagent.md:5).
- usage.md:134: the paragraph says Anthropic's page has plugin hooks loading in Cowork, then says hooks are why it does not work there, without saying what the maintainer observed. Say what was seen.
- hooks.md:96 "a Windows machine without Git Bash can run them" is a documented-behavior claim. It is untested here, and the Git Bash state of the test machine is unknown (see question above).
- README.md:18 points the claude.ai and "desktop app" status to requirements.md#supported-environments, but that table has no desktop-app row (requirements.md:24-33). Pre-existing (base README.md:18 is the same).
- README.md has no direct links to the claude.ai section or to "Getting mise"; both are reached through the pages it links (README.md:18, :30). Acceptable.
- Previous findings: the blocking solo-bullet finding (usage.md:14) is closed. The text now says an owned repository with no tracked state and no independent-PR convention gets `branch`, matching version-control.md:13-18 and decisions.md:51 (and usage.md:87). "One for each model alias" is gone. The "plan's usage" claim is replaced by a sourced price claim, still unverified. windows-install.ps1:23 is closed and has no dangling pointer. The hooks.md Git Bash item is partly closed (see question above). The Cowork question is answered by the requirement text, but the license sentence (blocker 1) remains.
